_about: Synthetic test scenarios. required_facts / forbidden_facts are exact substrings of the documents in docs/: a retrieved chunk covers a fact only if the whole sentence fragment is inside that one chunk. output_checks / output_forbidden are case-insensitive regexes applied to Qwen's draft (approximate, for comparison between routes only). primary_tests drive the form-section queries; scope_types drive the metadata filter. Facts from docs_extended/ only occur when the extended library is searched.

scenarios.request: I need warpage measured on 10 LCP connector housings (synthetic part SYN-CONN-400, 400 positions, 0.8 mm pitch) through a lead-free reflow cycle. The customer wants to know whether coplanarity stays within 0.10 mm at peak temperature. Please prepare the lab request.
required_facts: A request without a thermal profile cannot be scheduled
must include 25 C before heating, peak temperature, and 25 C after cooling
the measurement area and datum
Samples must be moisture-preconditioned per SYN-PR-201 before the baseline measurement
A minimum of 5 samples per test condition is required
Measure each sample at 25 C as the baseline
Samples must not be run through a second profile
Bake samples at 125 C for 24 hours
sample storage history since molding
whether contour maps are required for every sample
forbidden_facts: Moisture preconditioning before warpage measurement is optional
A minimum of 3 samples per test condition is required
A minimum of 10 samples per lot is required
No thermal profile is required
Bake samples at 105 C for 8 hours
